notes: Cold and dry. Low prices, clear skies, minimal snow in central Tokyo.
Coldest month on average. Good for plum blossoms late in month.
Cherry-blossom season begins late March. Book accommodation months ahead.
Peak sakura and Golden Week ramps up at end of month. Very high demand.
Pleasant temps, Golden Week early May is a domestic travel spike.
Rainy season (tsuyu). Lower prices and fewer crowds; pack a compact umbrella.
Hot and humid; fireworks festivals (hanabi) start late July.
Hottest month; Obon (mid-August) is a major domestic travel period.
Typhoon season. Check advisories; otherwise fewer crowds.
Autumn colors build through the month. Pleasant highs and dry-ish late month.
Peak autumn foliage mid-late November. Crisp, mostly sunny days.
Illuminations and year-end holidays; many small businesses close Dec 29-Jan 3.
